label: Town of Richmond
header:
# Town of Richmond municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 19; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 143 (Town of Richmond): the charter leaves the moderator to general law; section 302(c) provides the town shall not have a Road Commissioner, Town Agent, Town Auditor, or Town Grand Juror, so no posts are created for those offices
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Richmond, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED and APPOINTED officials tables: Clinton Buxton, Moderator on a one-year term expiring at the 2026 meeting. The 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Richmond, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED and APPOINTED officials tables: Susanne Parent, Town Clerk, won the contested 2025 race (502-485 over Katie Nelson) for a term to 2028
Town of Richmond, Town Clerk page (richmondvt.gov): Susanne Parent is the Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Richmond, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED and APPOINTED officials tables: James Feinson, Town Treasurer, re-elected in 2025 unopposed for a term to 2028
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists James Feinson as Richmond's Town Treasurer
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 143 (Town of Richmond): section 501: the Selectboard has five members, one three-year and one two-year seat elected each year

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Richmond's five selectboard members: Caitlin Filkins, David Sander, Bard Hill, Gregory Rabideau, and Adam Wood

Town of Richmond, All Committee & Board Members page (richmondvt.gov): the town's current roster, with Elected/Appointment types and term dates: Adam Wood (Chair, 2026-2028), Caitlin Filkins (Vice Chair, 2025-2027), Greg Rabideau (2024-2027), Bard Hill (2025-2028), and David Sander (2026-2029), each typed Elected. Rabideau's history is disclosed: the town report styles him 'Appointed Mid-Term Until Town Meeting 3/3/2026', and the town's current members page carries him as Elected for the seat running to 2027, so he is recorded as elected

Town of Richmond, 2025 Town Report, ELECTED and APPOINTED officials tables: Andy Squires held the elected one-year constable office to 2026. The 2026 outcome is published nowhere official, so the post is created without a membership
